title: E0117: SQL injection via query string
plain_english: Building SQL queries by concatenating query string input (`$_GET`) can allow SQL injection.
why_matters: SQL injection through query string parameters is risky because: - Query parameters are easy to modify and share in URLs - Attacks can be automated with simple URL manipulation - Search and filter endpoints are common targets
what_it_checks: SQL queries built by string concatenation with query string input
